empirical_vehicle_reference.name: CATS-Lab public samples derived from Waymo Motion
empirical_vehicle_reference.sampling: 8 stops and 8 straight through, 91 frames each, 0.1-second sampling per README, selected by published labels
empirical_vehicle_reference.limitation: not a single complete intersection recording; no cross-vehicle queue length, full signal programme or real policy outcomes
empirical_vehicle_reference.state_code_warning: raw source uses -1 undocumented as well as 0 unknown; not all nearest-light states may correspond to current car's controlling movement
